# User@Host: report[report] @ 10.0.2.3 []
# Query_time: 5.800  Lock_time: 0.001
# Rows_sent: 500  Rows_examined: 1200000
SET timestamp=1747811100;
# 多表 JOIN：orders 驱动，items 无合适索引时易大范围扫描
SELECT o.id, o.created_at, i.sku, i.qty
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.created_at >= '2026-01-01'
  AND o.status = 'shipped'
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
LIMIT 500;
